component.name: SignalTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "send" end sub
' POST one JSON signal (the remote's default resting pane) to pub's ' pub-signals endpoint, then report the HTTP status (-1: no answer in 5 s). sub send() port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") http = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") http.SetMessagePort(port) http.SetUrl(m.top.url) http.AddHeader("Content-Type", "application/json") code = -1 if http.AsyncPostFromString(m.top.body) msg = wait(5000, port) if type(msg) = "roUrlEvent" code = msg.GetResponseCode() else http.AsyncCancel() end if end if m.top.status = code end sub
